title: MMA-ASIA: A MULTILINGUAL AND MULTI-MODAL ALIGNMENT FRAMEWORK FOR CULTURALLY-GROUNDED EVALUATION

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model accuracy, reasoning generalization, and grounding validity on a human-curated, multi-modal multiple-choice question benchmark (MMA-ASIA) that covers specific cultural knowledge spanning 8 Asian countries, comparing performance disparities across these different cultural contexts.

Measuring cross-lingual consistency and performance gaps by querying models with semantically equivalent prompts in 10 different languages, comparing accuracy and cultural awareness grounding between high-resource languages (like English) and lower-resource Asian languages.
